materials.title: Approved Python reference
materials.content: A function groups reusable behavior. The def keyword defines a function. Parameters receive input and return passes a result to the caller. A function that reaches its end without return produces None. Encapsulation groups data and behavior behind an interface. Composition combines objects to provide behavior. Unit tests compare expected and actual behavior, including boundary cases.
